title: H2: how should deliberately invalid held-out files count?
question: The frozen held-out population has 25 files, including two deliberately invalid negative fixtures. PLAN_V1_1.md requires at least 95% to import and match exactly, so the maximum is 23/25 (92%). Recommended: apply 95% exact import to the 23 positive files and separately require clear, actionable rejection of both negatives. Preserve all 25 files, frozen labels and split, and report both original whole-population and positive-only results. Three native projects already passed once; 22 vectors remain unevaluated. This carries forward the existing unanswered scoring question. Changing this written gate requires your explicit answer. The fallback keeps the gate unchanged and H2 open; silence or an automatic default will not authorize a change or held-out evaluation.
options: Use 23 positives for 95%; require both negative rejections
Keep the original gate and leave H2 open
answer: Keep the original gate and leave H2 open
